cl_opi_sleep.q: Will I sleep badly when I stop heroin or other opioids?
cl_opi_sleep.short: Studies in one review found shorter, lighter sleep in the first weeks after stopping heroin.
cl_opi_sleep.but: This comes second-hand from a review that did not check how good the studies were.
how: Sleep labs recorded people in their first weeks off heroin and compared them with good sleepers.
They slept less, slept more lightly, and took longer to fall asleep.
Many people on methadone also sleep badly, and long-term opioid use can cause pauses in breathing during sleep.

cl_alc_sleep_stopping.q: Does alcohol help me sleep, and what happens to my sleep when I stop?
cl_alc_sleep_stopping.short: Alcohol can help people fall asleep at first, but studies in one review found long heavy drinking leaves sleep poor for months.
cl_alc_sleep_stopping.but: This comes second-hand from a review that did not check how good the studies were.
how: Sleep labs compared people who had drunk heavily for a long time with good sleepers.
Many slept badly while drinking and for weeks or months after stopping, with less deep sleep.
People who slept badly after stopping were more likely to start drinking again.

cl_can_sleep_stopping.q: Will I sleep badly when I stop cannabis?
cl_can_sleep_stopping.short: Studies in one review found that many people who used cannabis daily sleep badly after stopping, often with strange dreams.
cl_can_sleep_stopping.but: This comes second-hand from a review that did not check how good the studies were.
how: Studies asked people how they slept after stopping regular cannabis, and some recorded their sleep in a lab.
Between about a third and three quarters had sleep problems, often with strange dreams for days or weeks.
In the lab they took longer to fall asleep and woke up more than before they stopped.
Poor sleep was linked with going back to cannabis.

cl_xc_sleep_medicines.q: Can sleep medicines help when I stop alcohol, cannabis, cocaine or opioids?
cl_xc_sleep_medicines.short: Some helped sleep, but better sleep did not reliably help people stay off drugs.
cl_xc_sleep_medicines.but: This comes second-hand from a review that did not check how good the studies were.
how: Trials gave people who were stopping a drug either a sleep medicine or a dummy pill.
For alcohol, gabapentin mostly helped, but in one big trial trazodone was linked with more drinking.
For cannabis, several medicines helped sleep, but none clearly helped people stay off it.
For opioids, trazodone did not help people on methadone sleep better.

cl_ghb_driving.short: Soon after GHB, people crashed far more in a driving test than after a dummy drink.
cl_ghb_driving.but: Only 16 people new to GHB, one dose, no alcohol, in a lab driving machine.
how: 16 healthy adults used a lab driving machine after GHB on one day and after a dummy drink on another.
On the first drive after GHB, every one of them crashed more than after the dummy drink.
Later drives that day were not clearly worse, but this small study cannot show when driving is safe again.
Four people threw up after GHB and could not drive at all, so they were left out.

cl_ghb_thinking_after.q: Does GHB affect my memory or thinking afterwards?
cl_ghb_thinking_after.short: GHB affects memory while it works; lasting effects were only studied after many GHB comas.
cl_ghb_thinking_after.but: That one Dutch study cannot show GHB caused the memory problems, and nobody checked if they improve.
how: Lab studies found that GHB affects memory and coordination while it is working.
No study tested thinking in the days after taking GHB once.
One study found that people who had passed out from GHB many times had worse memory than people who used GHB without passing out, and than people who never used it.

cl_xc_afterglow.q: How do people feel in the days and weeks after a psychedelic?
cl_xc_afterglow.short: Studies often found less low mood and stress than before, and more wellbeing; some people had headaches or slept badly.
cl_xc_afterglow.but: Most studies had no comparison group and took place with support, not at parties or at home.
how: A review collected 48 studies of psilocybin, LSD, ayahuasca and similar drugs.
People filled in the same questionnaires before, and again up to a month after.
Most studies that measured it found less depression and stress, and more wellbeing, than before.
In studies that looked for problems, headaches were most common, and a few people had serious anxiety.

cl_xc_flashbacks.q: Can I get flashbacks after LSD or psilocybin?
cl_xc_flashbacks.short: About 1 in 11 lab volunteers reported a short flashback, mostly in the days after.
cl_xc_flashbacks.but: These were healthy, screened volunteers in labs, with no drug-free group to compare.
how: 142 healthy adults took LSD, psilocybin or both in lab studies in Switzerland.
At the end, 13 said they had had a flashback, usually a few seconds of changed seeing.
Most did not mind it; 2 people were upset by it.
Nobody developed the long-lasting vision condition doctors call HPPD.
